title: Code Grader
description: A platform for grading and optimising user code submissions using Large Language Models. Built to handle concurrent evaluations with feedback on complexity, style, and correctness.
constraint: Evaluate submitted code asynchronously while keeping feedback understandable for learners.
highlight: LLM-backed grading service focused on correctness, complexity, and style feedback.
evidence: Feedback categories for complexity, style, and correctness
result: A backend repository and walkthrough demonstrate the grading flow end to end.
tradeoffs: Used LLM feedback to make review output more explanatory than static checks alone
Kept grading concerns in a backend service instead of coupling them to the interface

title: Vimero
description: A microservices video-sharing platform engineered for horizontal scalability. Handles transcoding, CDN distribution, and real-time analytics.
constraint: Keep video processing asynchronous and retryable while the interface stays responsive.
highlight: Service-oriented video platform with queue-backed processing and realtime state.
evidence: Separate services for upload, processing, and delivery
result: A deployed demo and walkthrough show the upload, processing, and viewing flow.
tradeoffs: Split services to make scaling boundaries visible
Used queueing to keep expensive media work out of request paths

title: Analytics API
description: An admin panel dashboard for analytics of user activity and engagement. Built with high-performance aggregation pipelines.
constraint: Present activity data through a dashboard without making aggregation logic leak into the UI.
highlight: Django REST API and Next.js dashboard organized around analytics aggregation.
evidence: Django REST backend for analytics endpoints
Dashboard frontend for activity and engagement views
result: A deployed dashboard, repository, and walkthrough demonstrate the analytics workflow.
tradeoffs: Kept aggregation responsibilities server-side to simplify dashboard components
Used a REST API boundary to separate data shaping from presentation

title: Snappio Backend
description: Backend for a social media and chat application. Real-time messaging via WebSockets with PostgreSQL persistence.
constraint: Support chat-style realtime updates while preserving durable relational data.
highlight: Django Channels backend combining WebSocket messaging, Redis, and PostgreSQL persistence.
result: A Swagger deployment, backend repository, and walkthrough document the API surface.
tradeoffs: Used Channels to keep realtime communication in the Django ecosystem
Paired WebSockets with relational persistence instead of treating chat as transient-only state

title: Computer Shop
description: A full-stack e-commerce web application with cart, checkout, and order management. Optimized for performance and SEO.

title: SmartShala (SIH 2022)
description: SmartShala is a mobile application that aims to automate the grading process using AI/ML to scan answer sheets and upload the results to teacher portal.

title: Calories Tracker API
description: A REST API for tracking calories and macronutrients of food items via Natural Language Processing.

title: Cipherschools Profile Page
description: A clone of Cipherschools profile page with a backend for storing user data.

title: Digital Whiteboard
description: A digital whiteboard for drawing and writing.

title: PeerMessaging
description: A completely decentralized peer to peer messaging and video-calling application.
constraint: Make direct peer-to-peer communication usable in the browser without routing message content through an application backend.
highlight: PeerJS-based messaging and video calling experience built around direct browser connections.
evidence: PeerJS connection flow for peer-to-peer communication
result: A deployed demo and repository show the peer messaging and calling experience.
tradeoffs: Relied on browser peer connections to avoid a message relay backend
Kept state client-side, accepting browser connectivity constraints as part of the design

title: JWT Posts API
description: A REST API for creating and fetching posts using JWT authentication.
